The ninth public release candidate of the NPMplus Security Fork, for test servers ahead of a stable release. It replaces RC8.

### Action required

None - routine update. The second-factor migration to per-row storage runs automatically and preserves every enrolled secret; the installer is now v1.60.

### Security

- Completed the upstream reconciliation without giving up a fork protection: MFA token reuse is blocked on the new per-row factor model, TOTP and backup codes stay single-use, and enrollments migrate without resetting their secrets.
- CrowdSec detection datafiles are seeded from the image as real files before first start, so signature refreshes no longer fail silently on the read-only root filesystem. Operator-modified CrowdSec files and hub-upgraded data survive updates; only the image's own staging links are replaced.
- Installer steps that seed CrowdSec data or refresh its hub now fail loudly instead of reporting success through a swallowed exit code.

### Changed

- The CrowdSec dashboard lands on the Overview tab again; the Attackers investigation view stays one click away. This supersedes RC8's Attackers-first default.
- The fork's Caddy image pins its OTLP log modules to a line fixing a published TLS advisory and scans clean at medium severity and above.
- Adopted from upstream: Alpine 3.24.2, a stricter certificate domain-name pattern, and additional input validations. Dependency bumps inside the supply-chain freshness window stay held for the automated aging cron.

### Fixed

- The ban details panel no longer restates the same attack for every alert.
- Access-list password hashing runs asynchronously instead of blocking the event loop, and documentation claims that had drifted from the code were corrected.

### Upgrade

Copy and paste the complete command:

```bash
wget -qO setup-npmplus.sh https://github.com/mangyan1/NPMplus/releases/download/v2.15.1-mangyan1.rc.9/setup-npmplus.sh &&
wget -qO setup-npmplus.sh.sha256 https://github.com/mangyan1/NPMplus/releases/download/v2.15.1-mangyan1.rc.9/setup-npmplus.sh.sha256 &&
sha256sum -c setup-npmplus.sh.sha256 &&
sudo bash setup-npmplus.sh
```

Choose **Install NPMplus** for a fresh test VM or **Safe update** for an existing installer-managed one. Safe update repairs known configuration drift before the normal snapshot, health check, and automatic rollback protection.

Please report problems through [GitHub issues](https://github.com/mangyan1/NPMplus/issues). Report security vulnerabilities privately through the repository Security page.
